pages.text: $(li)Standard radiation scrubbers do not fully clean corium setups while corium remains present; use the multi scrubber for corium setups.
$(li)To avoid voiding needed fluids from radioactive ethereal goo, funnel excess into a target fluid via void upgrades, prioritizing the least-consumed fluid.
$(li)Corium is needed to craft the Unholy Radioactive Mixture, which is processed into Einsteinium and then used to make Naquadah.
$(li)Larger corium reactor volumes improve casing efficiency: although ~50% of casings are lost per meltdown, casing loss scales with surface area while volume (and thus corium yield) scales faster.

$(li)For passive corium production, build a reactor inside a space chamber using two builders (one to construct, one to pump), a Phantomface for fuel input, and redstone logic (fluid level emitter + timers) to cycle construction and pumping.

Link the controller to the Phantomface for fuel input; the connection persists even if the controller is destroyed.$(li)Use LEU-235 as fuel: it's cheap and doesn't kill you. Set builders to [On to activate] and [Keep running with redstone signal].
